name: User Notifications
author: Dog Byte Marketing

sections.description:
Notifications for WordPress & WooCommerce lets you seamlessly inform users about updates, promotions, or messages via the site navigation menu. With a user-friendly shortcode [notifications_dogbytemarketing] to inject into your menu, you can embed a dynamic notification bell anywhere in your menu. The bell displays a badge when new notifications are available, ensuring users never miss an update. If you use something other than Font Awesome icons, you can do [notifications_dogbytemarketing class=”your-icon-class”] to use your own icons.

This plugin is ideal for websites and WooCommerce stores looking to improve user engagement and streamline notification delivery.

Features

  • Custom post type for creating and managing notifications.
  • Integration with WordPress menus using a shortcode.
  • Dynamic badge display to highlight unread notifications.
  • Sidebar notifications for detailed views of messages.
  • Clean and modern design with customizable icons and styles.

Roadmap

  • WooCommerce integration

GDPR

We are not lawyers and always recommend doing your own compliance research into third party plugins, libraries, ect, as we’ve seen other plugins not be in compliance with these regulations.

This plugin uses the Font Awesome 3rd party library. This library is loaded locally to be compliant with data protection regulations.

This plugin collects and stores certain data on your server to ensure proper functionality. This includes:

  • Storing plugin settings
  • Remembering which notices have been dismissed
sections.installation:
1. Backup WordPress
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress

short_description: Easily display a notification bell with a badge count in your WordPress menu to notify users of new updates, promotions, and more.
